---
title: "Catálogo de Gates"
description: "Todos os gates do Anchors, por grupo: o que cada um mede e os tipos de artefato que confronta."

<!-- gate-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the gate catalog and the checker's spec; edit those, not this block -->

Cada gate abaixo é gerado do catálogo no código. O `anchors init` semeia os que têm relação com as camadas e artefatos que o projeto declara; o `anchors doctor` lista o catálogo inteiro, e o `anchors check --all` aponta os gates que cobrem o que o projeto declara mas não estão declarados.

## A Unidade e Estrutura

| Gate | Confronta | O que mede |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`unit-complete`](/pt/docs/gates/unit-complete/) | `spec` | The spec has code, feature and test that realise it |
| [`spec-has-code`](/pt/docs/gates/spec-has-code/) | `spec` | The spec carries a scenario code (identity) |
| [`spec-complete`](/pt/docs/gates/spec-complete/) | `spec` | The spec has at least one state/rule, with no placeholder |
| [`feature-not-empty`](/pt/docs/gates/feature-not-empty/) | `feature` | The feature is not an empty skeleton |
| [`spec-feature-match`](/pt/docs/gates/spec-feature-match/) | `spec` | Every requirement declared in the spec has a scenario in the feature |
| [`feature-spec-match`](/pt/docs/gates/feature-spec-match/) | `feature` | Every scenario of the feature matches a rule the spec declares |
| [`feature-test-match`](/pt/docs/gates/feature-test-match/) | `feature` | Every scenario of the feature is implemented in the linked test, by code and by description |
| [`test-feature-match`](/pt/docs/gates/test-feature-match/) | `test` | Every code the test proves matches a declared scenario |
| [`scenario-identity`](/pt/docs/gates/scenario-identity/) | `feature` | Each scenario code identifies one scenario: no code repeated and no body copied under another title |
| [`scenario-asserts`](/pt/docs/gates/scenario-asserts/) | `feature` | The outcome step asserts an observable outcome |
| [`scenario-type-aligned`](/pt/docs/gates/scenario-type-aligned/) | `feature` | A scenario's nature tag agrees with the letter of its code |
| [`scenario-letter-declared`](/pt/docs/gates/scenario-letter-declared/) | `feature` | Every scenario code's letter is a rule letter — the project's `rule_types`, or the canonical ones |
| [`code-reference-valid`](/pt/docs/gates/code-reference-valid/) | `spec` | Every code the spec cites exists in the project |
| [`code-cataloged`](/pt/docs/gates/code-cataloged/) | `spec` | Every exported symbol has a rule in the spec or a written waiver |
| [`placeholder-filled`](/pt/docs/gates/placeholder-filled/) | `spec` `feature` | No generator placeholder remains in a value position: header field, table cell, rule or title line |
| [`header-valid`](/pt/docs/gates/header-valid/) | `spec` `feature` `code` `test` `guide` `doc` `plan` `product` `flag` | The @anchors header carries the artifact's identity |
| [`header-layer-declared`](/pt/docs/gates/header-layer-declared/) | `spec` `feature` `code` `test` | The layer a header declares is one the Estrutura has |
| [`ref-resolves`](/pt/docs/gates/ref-resolves/) | `code` `feature` `test` | The `ref:` points at the sibling spec's `code:` |
| [`examples-match`](/pt/docs/gates/examples-match/) | `feature` | Every row of an outline's Examples is run by a test citing the scenario |

## Apresentação e Telas

| Gate | Confronta | O que mede |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`presentation-exhaustive`](/pt/docs/gates/presentation-exhaustive/) | `spec` | Every value of a prop or state the presentation reads has an appearance decided |
| [`presentation-conflict`](/pt/docs/gates/presentation-conflict/) | `spec` | One prop and one condition do not lead to two appearances |
| [`presentation-copy-single-source`](/pt/docs/gates/presentation-copy-single-source/) | `spec` | The text a presentation shows is a message code, not copy repeated in the rule |
| [`presentation-observable`](/pt/docs/gates/presentation-observable/) | `spec` | What a presentation changes is an element a test can point at |
| [`identity-consistent`](/pt/docs/gates/identity-consistent/) | `spec` | The spec's code is the only identity across its surfaces: testID prefixes and visual baselines |
| [`testid-consistent`](/pt/docs/gates/testid-consistent/) | `spec` | The spec's testID inventory, the IDs the code exposes, and the tests that query them agree |
| [`testid-queried-exists`](/pt/docs/gates/testid-queried-exists/) | `test` | Every handle an end-to-end flow queries is exposed somewhere in the code |
| [`vr-baseline`](/pt/docs/gates/vr-baseline/) | `feature` | Every visual-regression scenario has its baseline image |
| [`vr-states-covered`](/pt/docs/gates/vr-states-covered/) | `code` | Every state the visual unit's spec registers has a visual-regression scenario in the feature, unless exempted with `@no-vr: <reason>` |
| [`vr-scenarios-tested`](/pt/docs/gates/vr-scenarios-tested/) | `code` | Every visual-regression scenario of the unit has a VR test and a baseline image |
| [`vr-scenarios-of-states`](/pt/docs/gates/vr-scenarios-of-states/) | `code` | Every visual-regression scenario of the unit is of a state its spec registers |
| [`vr-tests-of-scenarios`](/pt/docs/gates/vr-tests-of-scenarios/) | `code` | Every VR test of the unit is of a visual-regression scenario its feature declares |
| [`validation-transitions`](/pt/docs/gates/validation-transitions/) | `code` | Every validation of a visual unit is the trigger of a state transition, or says `@no-state: <reason>` |
| [`error-message-declared`](/pt/docs/gates/error-message-declared/) | `code` | Every error of a visual unit names the message it shows, or says `@no-message: <reason>` |

| [`doc-required`](/pt/docs/gates/doc-required/) | `spec` | The contracted documents exist and mention the units that trigger them |

## Fronteiras Arquiteturais

| Gate | Confronta | O que mede |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`layer-boundary`](/pt/docs/gates/layer-boundary/) | `code` | The layer does not reach what is not its own (`boundaries:`) |
| [`sibling-guard`](/pt/docs/gates/sibling-guard/) | `code` | Sibling functions handle the same parameter consistently |
| [`proof-crosses-boundary`](/pt/docs/gates/proof-crosses-boundary/) | `spec` | A rule asserting a relation with another unit has the code importing that unit |
| [`circular`](/pt/docs/gates/circular/) | `code` | There is no import cycle between modules |
| [`deadcode`](/pt/docs/gates/deadcode/) | `code` | There is no orphan export, symbol or file in the project |

| Gate | Confronta | O que mede |
| --- | --- | --- |

| --- | --- | --- |
| [`phase-exists`](/pt/docs/gates/phase-exists/) | `spec` | The spec's `needs:` points at a phase some plan catalogues |

| [`plan-revised`](/pt/docs/gates/plan-revised/) | `plan` | A plan revised by another tells whoever reads it |

| [`open-questions-resolved`](/pt/docs/gates/open-questions-resolved/) | `spec` | The spec has no open question — implementing is not guessing |
| [`progress-honest`](/pt/docs/gates/progress-honest/) | `plan` | The plan's progress file tells the truth about the disk |
| [`revision-orphans`](/pt/docs/gates/revision-orphans/) | `spec` | The revision names the sibling rules that speak of the same subject |

## Prova e Execução

| Gate | Confronta | O que mede |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`tests-green`](/pt/docs/gates/tests-green/) | `test` | This file's tests pass (from the ingested result) |
| [`test-has-assertion`](/pt/docs/gates/test-has-assertion/) | `test` | Every test asserts something in its body — the project says what an assertion is |
| [`test-exercises-unit`](/pt/docs/gates/test-exercises-unit/) | `test` | A test reaches the unit it tests, and does not define a copy of it |
| [`test-ref-matches-unit`](/pt/docs/gates/test-ref-matches-unit/) | `test` | A test reaches the unit its `ref:` names — by import, a name it defines, or a declared invocation |
| [`evidence-fresh`](/pt/docs/gates/evidence-fresh/) | `test` | The test's last green run still holds: neither the test nor any file in its closure changed since it ran |
| [`line-coverage`](/pt/docs/gates/line-coverage/) | `code` | Line coverage >= threshold (from the ingested lcov) |
| [`branch-coverage`](/pt/docs/gates/branch-coverage/) | `code` | The tests take the branches the lcov lists (BRDA), and none is likely dead |
| [`coverage-delta`](/pt/docs/gates/coverage-delta/) | `code` | Line coverage did not drop vs. the previous ingestion |
| [`mutation-score`](/pt/docs/gates/mutation-score/) | `code` | The test PROVES the line: killed mutants >= threshold (from the ingested mutation report) |
| [`scenario-coverage`](/pt/docs/gates/scenario-coverage/) | `spec` | Each scenario of the spec has a passing test (semantic coverage) |
| [`single-test-per-unit`](/pt/docs/gates/single-test-per-unit/) | `code` | A unit has one test file per test layer, or declares the split with a reason |
| [`test-level-codes`](/pt/docs/gates/test-level-codes/) | — |  |
| [`test-traceable`](/pt/docs/gates/test-traceable/) | `test` | The test cites the code of what it proves (visible to the relational gates) |

| [`pagination-honored`](/pt/docs/gates/pagination-honored/) | `code` | A function promising the whole set does not silently return the first page |
| [`route-declared`](/pt/docs/gates/route-declared/) | `spec` | A screen spec declares its route and names its neighbour screens |

| [`dependency-honored`](/pt/docs/gates/dependency-honored/) | `spec` | The methods declared in the Dependencies Table are used in the code |

| [`value-anchored`](/pt/docs/gates/value-anchored/) | `code` | Each declared value anchor matches the code below it, its spec rule's value, and every other declaration of the same key |
